            <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 14px;">
                <div class="sim-form-group">
                    <div class="sim-form-label">
                        <span>Outage Duration</span>
                        <span id="customDurationLabel" class="slider-readout-pill">36h</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="slider-row">
                        <input type="range" class="slider-control" id="customDurationSlider" min="8" max="168" step="4" value="36" oninput="document.getElementById('customDurationLabel').innerText = this.value + 'h'" />
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="sim-form-group">
                    <div class="sim-form-label">
                        <span>Lost Capacity</span>
                        <span id="customCapacityLabel" class="slider-readout-pill" style="color: var(--status-alert);">100%</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="slider-row">
                        <input type="range" class="slider-control" id="customCapacitySlider" min="10" max="100" step="5" value="100" oninput="document.getElementById('customCapacityLabel').innerText = this.value + '%'" />
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="sim-form-group">
                <label class="sim-form-label">Target Customer Contracts Impacted</label>
                <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; background: #f8fafc; padding: 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);">
                    <label style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer;">
                        <input type="checkbox" id="chkCust1" checked="checked" /> BHEL Power Project (DN50 Standard)
                    </label>
                    <label style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer;">
                        <input type="checkbox" id="chkCust2" checked="checked" /> Thermax Heavy Engineering (Boiler Valves)
                    </label>
                    <label style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer;">
                        <input type="checkbox" id="chkCust3" checked="checked" /> Tata Steel Kalinganagar (Class 600 Gate)
                    </label>
                    <label style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer;">
                        <input type="checkbox" id="chkCust4" /> Indian Oil Refineries (10" Class 300)
                    </label>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="sim-form-group">
                <label class="sim-form-label">Custom Adaptive Playbook / Strategy</label>
                <textarea class="form-input-control" id="customScenStrategy" rows="3" style="resize: vertical; font-family: var(--font-sans);" placeholder="Describe reroute strategy and shifts...">Reroute primary turning ops to standby CNC Cell; activate 4h overtime on Line 1; protect high-priority contracts.</textarea>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="drawer-footer">
            <button class="btn-outline-green" onclick="closeCustomScenarioDrawer()">Cancel</button>
            <button class="btn-solid-blue" onclick="saveCustomScenario()">Direct Save to x_2056099_indust_0_sim_scenario & Run</button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ======================================================================= -->
    <!-- MODAL: EMERGENCY MAINTENANCE DISPATCH                                   -->
    <!-- ======================================================================= -->
    <div class="modal-backdrop" id="maintenanceModalBackdrop" onclick="closeMaintenanceModal()"></div>
    <div class="modal-backdrop" id="maintenanceModalContainer" style="display: none;">
        <div class="portal-modal" id="maintenanceModal" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
            <div class="modal-header">
                <div class="modal-title">
                    <span style="color: var(--status-alert); font-size: 18px;">⚡</span>
                    Dispatch Emergency Maintenance Work Order
                </div>
                <button class="drawer-close-btn" onclick="closeMaintenanceModal()">×</button>
            </div>
            <div class="modal-body">
                <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: var(--status-alert-bg); border: 1px solid var(--status-alert-border); padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); margin-bottom: 16px;">
                    <span class="stage-status-chip chip-bottleneck" style="font-weight: 800;">PRIORITY 1 - CRITICAL</span>
                    <span style="color: var(--status-alert); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600;">Automated Telemetry Threshold Breach Detected</span>
                </div>

                <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 16px;">
                    <div style="background: #f8fafc; padding: 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;">
                        <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 700;">Target Asset</div>
                        <div style="font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--brand-navy); margin-top: 2px;" id="maintAssetCode">MC-HYD-CNC-02</div>
                        <div style="font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-secondary);" id="maintAssetName">Precision Lathe Cell 02</div>
                    </div>
                    <div style="background: #f8fafc; padding: 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;">
                        <div style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 700;">Assigned Shift Crew</div>
                        <div style="font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--brand-navy); margin-top: 2px;" id="maintCrew">Crew Beta (6 Techs)</div>
                        <div style="font-size: 12px; color: var(--status-normal);">SLA Target: < 30 Minutes</div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div style="border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: 14px; margin-bottom: 16px;">
                    <div style="font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary); margin-bottom: 8px;">PRE-POPULATED SENSOR TELEMETRY</div>
                    <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 10px; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 12px;">
                        <div><span style="color: var(--text-muted);">Spindle Temp:</span> <strong style="color: var(--status-alert);" id="maintTemp">86.4°C</strong></div>
                        <div><span style="color: var(--text-muted);">Vibration:</span> <strong style="color: var(--status-alert);" id="maintVib">4.8 mm/s</strong></div>
                        <div><span style="color: var(--text-muted);">Load Ratio:</span> <strong id="maintLoad">92.0%</strong></div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="sim-form-group">
                    <label class="sim-form-label">ServiceNow Incident Short Description</label>
                    <input type="text" class="form-input-control" id="maintShortDesc" value="[Digital Twin Alert] Emergency Spindle Bearing Overheat (86.4°C) & Vibration Spike on MC-HYD-CNC-02" />
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="modal-footer">
                <button class="btn-outline-green" onclick="closeMaintenanceModal()">Cancel</button>
                <button class="btn-solid-blue" style="background: #b91c1c; border-color: #b91c1c;" onclick="confirmMaintenanceDispatch()">
                    <span>⚡</span> Dispatch Incident & Page Crew Beta
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ======================================================================= -->
    <!-- MODAL: INTER-PLANT BUFFER STOCK REBALANCING                             -->
    <!-- ======================================================================= -->
    <div class="modal-backdrop" id="stockRebalanceBackdrop" onclick="closeStockRebalanceModal()"></div>
    <div class="modal-backdrop" id="stockRebalanceContainer" style="display: none;">
        <div class="portal-modal" style="width: 640px;" id="stockRebalanceModal" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
            <div class="modal-header">
                <div class="modal-title">
                    <span style="color: var(--brand-blue); font-size: 18px;">⇄</span>
                    Sourcing Engine: Inter-Plant Buffer Stock Rebalancing
                </div>
                <button class="drawer-close-btn" onclick="closeStockRebalanceModal()">×</button>
            </div>
            <div class="modal-body">
                <div style="background: #fffbeb; border: 1px solid #fde68a; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); margin-bottom: 16px;">
                    <div style="font-weight: 700; color: #b45309; font-size: 12.5px;">Material Deficit Identified at Chennai Plant (WH-MAA)</div>
                    <div style="font-size: 12px; color: #92400e; margin-top: 3px;">
                        Component: <strong>Cast Steel Valve Body - DN50 (MAT-VLV-CS-50)</strong> • Shortage: <strong>40 Units</strong> • Foundry Delay: 7 Days
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div style="font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary); margin-bottom: 10px;">AVAILABLE WAREHOUSE SURPLUS SCANNED ACROSS NETWORK</div>

                <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 16px;">
                    <!-- Option 1: Hyderabad -->
                    <div style="border: 2px solid var(--brand-blue); background: #f0f7ff; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: 14px 16px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px;">
                        <div>
                            <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;">
                                <strong style="color: var(--brand-navy); font-size: 13.5px;">WH-HYD (Hyderabad Distribution Warehouse)</strong>
                                <span class="stage-status-chip chip-ok">RECOMMENDED MATCH</span>
                            </div>
                            <div style="font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-top: 4px;">
                                Available Surplus: <strong>65 Units</strong> (Safe Reserve: 20) • Transfer Qty: <strong>40 Units</strong>
                            </div>
                            <div style="font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 2px;">
                                Transit Time: <strong>14 Hours (Express Logistics)</strong> • Freight Cost: <strong>₹12,500</strong>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <button class="btn-solid-blue" onclick="executeStockTransfer('WH-HYD', 40, 14, 12500)" style="padding: 6px 14px; font-size: 12px; white-space: nowrap;">Dispatch Transfer →</button>
                    </div>

                    <!-- Option 2: Bengaluru -->
                    <div style="border: 1px solid var(--border-medium); background: #ffffff; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: 14px 16px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px;">
                        <div>
                            <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;">
                                <strong style="color: var(--brand-navy); font-size: 13.5px;">WH-BLR (Bengaluru Logistics Center)</strong>
                                <span class="tag-cell">Secondary Source</span>
                            </div>
                            <div style="font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-top: 4px;">
                                Available Surplus: <strong>28 Units</strong> • Max Transfer: <strong>18 Units (Partial)</strong>
                            </div>
                            <div style="font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 2px;">
                                Transit Time: <strong>8 Hours</strong> • Freight Cost: <strong>₹8,200</strong>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <button class="btn-outline-green" onclick="executeStockTransfer('WH-BLR', 18, 8, 8200)" style="padding: 6px 14px; font-size: 12px; white-space: nowrap;">Partial Transfer →</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="modal-footer">
                <button class="btn-outline-green" onclick="closeStockRebalanceModal()">Close</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ======================================================================= -->
    <!-- PRINT-READY EXECUTIVE OPERATIONS REPORT (1-PAGE PDF BRIEF)              -->
    <!-- ======================================================================= -->
    <div id="executivePrintReport">
        <div style="border-bottom: 2px solid #0f2438; padding-bottom: 12px; margin-bottom: 18px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end;">
            <div>
                <div style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; color: #0f2438; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em;">Industrial Supply Co.</div>
                <div style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #334155;">Operations Digital Twin • Incident & Adaptive Rescheduling Brief</div>
            </div>
            <div style="text-align: right; font-size: 11px; color: #64748b; font-family: monospace;">
                <div>DOC REF: <strong id="printDocRef">DOC-DT-SIM-2026-001</strong></div>
                <div>GENERATED: <span id="printTimestamp"></span></div>
                <div>INSTANCE: dev449562 (ServiceNow Production)</div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div style="margin-bottom: 16px;">
            <div style="font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 700; color: #64748b;">1. Disruption Overview & Root Cause Analysis</div>
            <div style="font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a; margin-top: 3px;" id="printScenarioTitle">Hyderabad Lathe Cell 02 • 48-Hour Unplanned Outage</div>
            <div style="font-size: 12px; color: #334155; margin-top: 4px; line-height: 1.5;" id="printRootCause">
                Unplanned spindle bearing failure on CNC Lathe MC-HYD-CNC-02. Telemetry registered 86.4°C temperature spike and 4.8 mm/s vibration harmonics.
            </div>
        </div>

        <div style="margin-bottom: 18px;">
            <div style="font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 700; color: #64748b; margin-bottom: 8px;">2. Operational Delivery Performance & SLA Recovery Summary</div>
            <table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 11.5px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;">
                <thead>
                    <tr style="background: #f1f5f9;">
                        <th style="padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; text-align: left;">Baseline Scheduled OTD</th>
                        <th style="padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; text-align: left; color: #b91c1c;">Unmitigated Disruption Drop</th>
                        <th style="padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; text-align: left; color: #047857;">Digital Twin Mitigated OTD</th>
                        <th style="padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; text-align: left;">Liquidated Damages Avoided</th>
                        <th style="padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; text-align: left;">Mitigation Delta Cost</th>
                    </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                    <tr>
                        <td style="padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; font-weight: 700;" id="printBaselineOTD">96.5%</td>
                        <td style="padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; font-weight: 700; color: #b91c1c;" id="printSimulatedOTD">74.0% (-22.5%)</td>
                        <td style="padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; font-weight: 700; color: #047857;" id="printOptimizedOTD">95.0% (+21.0% Recovery)</td>
                        <td style="padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; font-weight: 700; color: #047857;">₹4,80,000</td>
                        <td style="padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; font-weight: 700;" id="printCost">₹42,000 (11.4x ROI)</td>
                    </tr>
                </tbody>
            </table>
        </div>

        <div style="margin-bottom: 16px;">
            <div style="font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 700; color: #64748b;">3. Active Adaptive Rescheduling Strategy</div>
            <div style="font-size: 12px; color: #1e3a5f; background: #f0f7ff; border: 1px solid #bfdbfe; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 4px; margin-top: 4px;" id="printStrategy">
                Reroute critical operations to MC-HYD-CNC-01; activate 4-hour overtime shift on Crew Alpha; protect high-margin BHEL / Thermax orders.
            </div>
        </div>

        <div style="margin-bottom: 18px;">
            <div style="font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 700; color: #64748b; margin-bottom: 6px;">4. Protected VIP Customer Delivery Contracts</div>
            <table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 11px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;" id="printOrdersTable">
                <thead>
                    <tr style="background: #f1f5f9;">
                        <th style="padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; text-align: left;">Order Reference</th>
                        <th style="padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; text-align: left;">Customer</th>
                        <th style="padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; text-align: left;">Product / Valve BOM</th>
                        <th style="padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; text-align: center;">Qty</th>
                        <th style="padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; text-align: left;">Baseline Finish</th>
                        <th style="padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; text-align: left;">Adapted Finish</th>
                        <th style="padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; text-align: left;">Net Saved</th>
                    </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody id="printOrdersBody"></tbody>
            </table>
        </div>

        <div style="margin-top: 30px; border-top: 1px solid #cbd5e1; padding-top: 12px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 11px; color: #64748b;">
            <div>Authorized Sign-off: Operations Director & Plant Shift Lead</div>
            <div>Generated by ServiceNow What-If Digital Twin Portal</div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- TOAST NOTIFICATION -->
    <div class="portal-toast" id="portalToast">
        <span style="font-size: 16px; color: #34d399;">✔</span>
        <span id="portalToastMsg">Notification</span>
    
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- FOOTER -->
      <div class="page-footer">
        Industrial Inventory & Production Management • Powered by ServiceNow dev445579
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  

</div>

    <div class="modal-backdrop" id="detailModalBackdrop" onclick="closeDetailModal()">
      <div class="portal-modal" id="detailModal" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
        <div class="modal-header">
          <div class="modal-title">
            <span id="modalIcon" class="modal-icon-badge">📋</span>
            <div>
              <div id="modalTitle" class="modal-heading-text">Record Details</div>
              <div id="modalSubTitle" class="modal-subheading-text">Real-time Industrial Operations Telemetry</div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button type="button" class="modal-close-btn" onclick="closeDetailModal()" aria-label="Close">×</button>
        </div>
        <div class="modal-body" id="modalBody"></div>
        <div class="modal-footer">
          <button type="button" class="btn-modal-secondary" onclick="closeDetailModal()">Close</button>
          <button type="button" class="btn-modal-primary" id="modalActionBtn" onclick="onModalPrimaryAction()">View in ServiceNow</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>


</j:jelly>
